Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules associated with document CHEMBL1123858. Source data from molecule_dictionary, compound_records, and compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, and compound_records to docs on doc_id. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter where docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1123858' and canonical_smiles is not null. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles in ascending order.
